title: K-Box Karaoke
specs: Professional music equipment in private rooms
Valid government-issued photo ID and valid credit card required for all room rentals (school IDs accepted)
All ages welcome except in rooms containing alcohol; under 21 prohibited in those rooms
Room capacities: Small up to 5, Medium up to 8, Medium+ up to 10, Large up to 14 people
Extra guests allowed only if space permits; exceeding capacity may result in ejection and full charge
blurb: K-BOX Karaoke offers cozy indoor private rooms with professional music equipment for singing and socializing. Rooms vary in size accommodating from 5 to 14 people. The venue is located in the Japan Center of San Francisco and operates by online booking only.
extraNote: $50 deposit required in advance to secure a reservation for private rooms · Late arrival up to 15 minutes allowed with call; over 15 minutes may result in cancellation and loss of deposit · Bringing own food and drink forbidden; violation results in ejection and full room charge · Damage to equipment or furniture must be paid for on the night; cleaning charges may apply · Casual dress code; inappropriate attire may result in refusal of entry and forfeiture of fees
